chapterInfo.content:
8
Nyansa kamfo ne ho
1 # Mmb 1.20-33 Ɛno ɛnyɛ nyansa na ɛteam,
na nteaseɛ ma ne nne soɔ?
2Sorɔnsorɔn atifi, ɔkwan so,
nkwanta so na ɛgyina,
3na ɔteam aponkɛseɛ ho,
kurotia, aboboano sɛ:
4Mo, mmarima, na meteam mefrɛ mo,
na me nne gyegye ma nnipa mma:
5Mo, ntetekwaa, momma mo ani nte,
na mo, nkwaseafoɔ, monnya nhunumu akoma.
6Montie, na merebɛka nsɛm a emu da hɔ,
na m’anomu bue de nsɛm a ɛtene ba;
7na nokorɛ firi m’anomu,
na m’ano akyiwadeɛ ne abɔnefosɛm;
8m’anomu nsɛm nyinaa nam tenenee mu,
adeɛ a akyinkyim anaasɛ ɛkyea nni mu;
9ne nyinaa mu da hɔ ma nhunumufoɔ,
na ɛtene ma wɔn a wɔahunu nimdeɛ.
10 # Mmb 3.14 Momfa m’atenetene, na ɛnyɛ dwetɛ,
na momfa nimdeɛ, na monnya sika a wɔayiyi mu.
11Na nyansa yɛ sene mmota,
na afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa, wɔmfa nto ho.
12Me, nyansa, me ne aniteɛ na ɛteɛ,
na adwempa nimdeɛ na mehunu.
13 # Mmb 6.12-19 AWURADE suro ne bɔne tane:
Ahokyerɛ, ahantan, ɔkwammɔne
ne akontonkyisɛm ano na mekyire.
14Afotuo ne nyansahunu wɔ me,
mene nhunumu, mmaninyɛ wɔ me.
15 # Mmb 16.12; Skf 10.16 Me so na ahemfo nam di hene,
na atitire hyɛ mmara tenenee;
16me so na mpanimfoɔ nam di panin,
ne aberempɔn, ne asase so atemmufoɔ nyinaa.
17Me deɛ, medɔ wɔn a wɔdɔ me,
na wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me ntɛm hu me.
18 # Mmb 3.16 Ahonyadeɛ ne animuonyam wɔ me hɔ,
ahodeɛ a ɛkyɛre ne tenenee.
19M’aba yɛ sene sika ne amapa,
na me nnɔbaeɛ sene dwetɛ a wɔayiyi mu.
20Tenenee tempɔn mu na menam,
atemmuo akwan so pɛ,
21sɛ merema m’adɔfo adi adeɛ,
na mahyɛ wɔn adekorabea amaama.
22 # Hiob 28.27 AWURADE bɔɔ me de firii n’adwuma ase,
ne nnwuma a ɛfiri teteete no mu adikan.
23Ɔde me sii hɔ firi tete nteredee,
firi mfitiaseɛ ansa na asase reba.
24Abunu nni hɔ no, na wɔawo me,
nsutire a ɛba nsuo pii nni hɔ no;
25wɔnnya mfaa mmepɔ nsisii hɔ,
na nkokoɔ nnya mmaeɛ no, na wɔawo me,
26ɔnnya nyɛɛ asase ne wiram
ne wiase mfuturo no.
27 # Hiob 26.10 Ɔsiesiee ɔsoro no, na mewɔ hɔ,
berɛ a ɔtwaa abunu ani kɔntɔnkrɔn no;
28ɔde mununkum sensɛnee soro pintinn,
na ebunu mu nsuo aniwa paee denden,
29 # Hiob 38.10-11; Dwom 104.9 ɔtwaa ɛpo hyeɛ, na nsuo antra,
na ɔde asase fapem too hɔ no,
30na mewɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ ne dwumfoɔ panin,
na meyɛ n’adɔdeɛ daa daa.
Na m’ani gye n’anim berɛ nyinaa mu,
31 # Deut 33.3 na m’ani gye ne wiase asase so,
na m’ani ka wɔ nnipa mma mu.
32Na afei, mma, montie me,
na nhyira ne wɔn a wɔdi m’akwan soɔ.
33Montie atenetene na monhunu nyansa,
na monnte atua.
34Nhyira ne onipa a ɔtie me
na ɔwɛn m’apono ano daa daa,
na ɔhwɛ m’aboboano aponnwa soɔ.
35 # Mmb 3.2 Na deɛ ɔhu me no hunu nkwa,
na ɔnya AWURADE hɔ anisɔ;
36na deɛ ɔfom me no di ne kra aborɔ,
wɔn a wɔtane me nyinaa dɔ owuo.

mene nhunumu, mmaninyɛ wɔ me.

sɛ merema m’adɔfo adi adeɛ,
na mahyɛ wɔn adekorabea amaama.
AWURADE bɔɔ me de firii n’adwuma ase,
ne nnwuma a ɛfiri teteete no mu adikan.
Ɔde me sii hɔ firi tete nteredee,

Abunu nni hɔ no, na wɔawo me,

ɔnnya nyɛɛ asase ne wiram
ne wiase mfuturo no.
Ɔsiesiee ɔsoro no, na mewɔ hɔ,

Na m’ani gye n’anim berɛ nyinaa mu,

Na afei, mma, montie me,

Montie atenetene na monhunu nyansa,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
